description: Verify peer identity by fetching their SSH or GPG public keys from GitHub (https://github.com/<user>.keys, https://api.github.com/users/<user>/gpg_keys). Peer presents a GitHub username + signs a challenge with a key listed on their GitHub profile. Stronger than bare TOFU because the key is bound to a GitHub identity with social proof (commit history, repos, followers). No infrastructure to operate — GitHub is the directory. Could also use GitHub's OIDC (OAuth app or GitHub App) as an alternative path. Works well for developer-to-developer chat where everyone already has a GitHub account.
title: Identity provider: GitHub key directory
